observations.autoReplay: RedisOptions.js default true; event_handler.js readyHandler replays prevCommandQueue separately from offlineQueue; maxRetriesPerRequest only flushes current queue after every second failed reconnect.
observations.shutdown: Redis.js _connect installs once ready/close; removeAllListeners steals these handlers. disconnect clears reconnectTimeout and connector closes stream with fallback disconnectTimeout2000ms.
observations.lateError: Redis.js silentEmit ignores end and selected manuallyClosing errors; otherwise reports raw error to console when no listeners. No real late-error leak was reproduced, so no separate claim of that bug. Guarded retained error listener covers late callbacks without stripping library listeners.
observations.events: Redis.js setStatus queues events via process.nextTick; service connect promise callbacks are stale relative to current state and must not change availability.
observations.timeout: Redis.js sendCommand attaches Command.setTimeout; Command.js rejects pending command at timeout. Event handler drops prevCommandQueue without replay when autoResendUnfulfilledCommands=false; timer bounds pending promise.
